title: Bows and shields: B1-B3, H2, H3 variations
desc: Three new builds each of 823's compound bow, Olympic recurve, hunting compound, tower shield and dome wall (J rated them IMPROVE with no note); every take is built a different way.

takes.name: compound: swept riser
takes.facts: one swept deflex riser with ports and a truss spine; parallel limbs; binary cams roll 200 deg on the draw; front + back bar; 4-pin; 4-vane arrow, lighted nock

takes.name: compound: machined plate
takes.facts: CNC plate riser with triangle cut-outs (R2 texture); hybrid cams; drop-away rest flips up, drops at the shot; caliper release opens at 31; offset V-bar

takes.name: compound: sliced riser
takes.facts: riser stacked from 34 slices with windows, outline rails trace first; single cam + idler; scope with lens and level; 0.7 rod

takes.name: Olympic: shape-key limbs
takes.facts: ILF riser plate with windows; limbs are smooth blades whose curve changes on the draw (shape key); clicker snaps at 34; spin-wing arrow spins in flight

takes.name: Olympic: laminated limbs
takes.facts: twin twisting ribbon riser; limbs of 3 laminations in 6 hinged segments flexing more toward the tips; forms tip to centre

takes.name: Olympic: faceted, bow rolls
takes.facts: faceted crystal riser; rigid sharp-recurve limbs; after the shot the bow rolls forward out of the open hand on a finger sling

takes.name: hunting: plate + mech heads
takes.facts: short ported plate riser (W1 texture); 7-pin sight; 5 mechanical broadheads in the quiver; blades open on impact in a foam block

takes.name: hunting: truss + rangefinder
takes.facts: carbon tube truss riser with nodes; rangefinder laser 12-17 reads 18, the single slider pin drops to 18; 2-blade cut-on-contact head

takes.name: hunting: cube riser, two shots
takes.facts: riser of half-pixel cubes; draw 12-20, release 25; takes a 2nd arrow from the quiver 27-32, draws 33-40, release 45

takes.name: tower: curved brick
takes.facts: curved tower 1.0 x 1.8 of offset BR1 brick courses built from the forearm out; hit ripple across the face

takes.name: tower: riot wall, kneel
takes.facts: flat W1 panel 1.0 x 1.9 with viewport; rim traces, panel fades in, kneel + foot spike planted at 9; cracks spread and heal

takes.name: tower: telescoping heater
takes.facts: 7 curved H1 slats slide out of the forearm into a 1.0 x 1.7 heater outline (3-11); hit rocks the slats back in a wave

takes.name: dome: geodesic cap
takes.facts: geodesic cap of ~100 triangle cells, 1.7 across, both hands bracing; forms in a spiral 2-11; rings of cells light out from the hit

takes.name: dome: planted wall
takes.facts: push from the ring hand; a curved wall 2.4 x 2.0 rises 1.6 blocks ahead from a ground line (6-14), leaning in like a dome; hit dents it

takes.name: dome: twin shells
takes.facts: outer X3 shell 1.6 across turning one way over an inner lattice of hex rings turning the other; hit flashes, pulse runs to the ring
